abstract: We hypothesize that polygyny acts as a significant push factor for migration in sub-Saharan Africa because it is associated with competition within polygynous families and on the marriage market, while also contributing to unfavorable economic and political outcomes at the societal level. Using cross-country data from 46 sub-Saharan African countries, we show that higher polygyny prevalence is associated with increased international emigration. We complement this macro-level evidence with original survey data from Senegal, the Gambia, and Nigeria. We show that polygyny is also associated with higher migration aspirations and observed migration of survey respondents’ siblings at the individual level. Respondents from polygynous families tend to report stronger economic motives for migration, while those concerned about the marriage market effects of polygyny—regardless of family background—are more likely to consider migrating for marriage. This highlights two distinct pathways—competition within polygynous families and on marriage markets—linking polygyny to migration.
abstract_zh: 我们假设，在撒哈拉以南非洲，一夫多妻制作为迁移的重要推动因素，因其与多妻家庭内部及婚姻市场上的竞争相关，同时也在社会层面导致不利的经济和政治后果。利用来自46个撒哈拉以南非洲国家的跨国数据，我们显示，一夫多妻制的普遍程度越高，国际移民外流越多。我们以来自塞内加尔、冈比亚和尼日利亚的原始调查数据补充这一宏观层面的证据。我们表明，在个体层面，一夫多妻制也与更高的迁移愿望及调查对象兄弟姐妹的实际迁移相关。来自多妻家庭的受访者倾向于报告更强的经济迁移动机，而那些担忧一夫多妻制对婚姻市场影响的人——无论家庭背景如何——更可能考虑为婚姻而迁移。这凸显了将一夫多妻制与迁移联系起来的两种不同路径：多妻家庭内部的竞争和婚姻市场上的竞争。
title: Polygyny as a determinant of migration
title_zh: 一夫多妻制作为迁移的决定因素

abstract: In recent decades, economists studying international trade have gained access to an unprecedented volume and variety of data. These data have provided new insights and a more granular understanding of the mechanics of trade. Analyzing a large corpus of papers, we document that the nature of research has also shifted. Previously, the typical trade paper was either purely theoretical or an empirical paper testing theoretical predictions. More recently, scholarship has shifted toward a more integrated approach, particularly quantitative modeling. This development is surprising. We might have expected the data revolution (and contemporaneous credibility revolution) to increase the share of primarily empirical papers—although the markers of these revolutions are clearly evident in the rise of causal inference within empirical work. This article reviews these developments, assessing the strengths and limitations of different modes of inquiry, and plotting a path forward to harness the growing richness of data within the field.
abstract_zh: 近几十年来，研究国际贸易的经济学家得以接触到前所未有的海量且多样化的数据。这些数据为理解贸易机制提供了新的洞见和更为精细的视角。通过分析大量论文，我们发现研究性质也发生了转变。以往，典型的贸易论文要么是纯理论性的，要么是检验理论预测的实证研究。而近年来，学术界更倾向于采用一种更为综合的方法，尤其是定量建模。这一发展出乎意料。我们或许会预期，数据革命（以及同时期的可信度革命）会提高以实证为主的论文比例——尽管这些革命的标志在实证研究中因果推断的兴起中显而易见。本文回顾了这些发展，评估了不同研究模式的优势与局限，并规划了在该领域内利用日益丰富数据的未来路径。
title: The Data Revolution, and It's Uses, in International Trade
title_zh: 数据革命及其在国际贸易中的应用

abstract: This paper examines the mental health consequences of China’s export slowdown from 2010 to 2016. Using nationally representative individual-level panel data and a shift-share instrument for city-level export exposure, we find that export slowdown significantly increased psychological distress. The effects are most pronounced in export-reliant regions and among middle-aged, less-educated individuals, production and manufacturing workers, and married women. We further show that export slowdowns operate through both level and distributional channels: they deteriorate labor market conditions and widen income inequality. At the household level, export slowdowns increase reliance on short-term borrowing, amplifying forward-looking financial stress, particularly for families with young children. Institutional and technological forces shape these impacts: stronger local social safety nets mitigate mental distress among vulnerable groups, while accelerated workplace automation exacerbates stress for employed workers. A one-standard-deviation decline in export exposure is associated with 44,686 disability-adjusted life years (DALYs) and mental health-related costs equivalent to 0.34% of China’s GDP in 2013. These findings reveal the uneven psychological costs of adverse trade shocks and highlight the importance of distribution-sensitive trade adjustment policies.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了2010至2016年间中国出口放缓对心理健康的影响。利用具有全国代表性的个体层面面板数据及针对城市出口暴露度的转移份额工具变量，我们发现出口放缓显著加剧了心理困扰。这一效应在依赖出口的地区以及中年、受教育程度较低个体、生产与制造业工人及已婚女性中最为突出。我们进一步表明，出口放缓通过水平与分配双重渠道发挥作用：既恶化了劳动力市场状况，又扩大了收入不平等。在家庭层面，出口放缓增加了对短期借贷的依赖，加剧了前瞻性财务压力，尤其对育有幼儿的家庭影响显著。制度与技术力量塑造了这些影响：更强大的地方社会安全网缓解了弱势群体的心理困扰，而工作场所自动化的加速则加剧了在职员工的心理压力。出口暴露度每下降一个标准差，与2013年中国44，686个伤残调整生命年及相当于GDP 0.34%的心理健康相关成本相关联。这些发现揭示了不利贸易冲击带来的不均衡心理成本，并强调了注重分配效应的贸易调整政策的重要性。
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: When exports decelerate: The mental health consequences of China’s export slowdown
title_zh: 当出口减速：中国出口放缓的心理健康后果

abstract: This article proposes a graph-based maximum pairwise difference (MPD) test to compare K-sample distributions. This test can be utilized to identify the most informative variables contributing to the heterogeneity of multiple multivariate distributions. To construct the test, we first pool observations from multiple samples to create a similarity graph based on the distances between any two observations. For each observation, we next evaluate its connection probability to each sample. Then, we doubly maximize the squared differences of these connection probabilities via the within and between samples. Accordingly, the MPD test is a max-of-squares test and can effectively detect sparse alternatives. In addition, we show the asymptotic null distribution of the test statistic and establish its consistency under alternatives. To illustrate the finite sample performance of the proposed test, we conduct extensive simulation studies. The results indicate that the MPD test outperforms some commonly used multisample tests. Finally, we employ it to select relevant features related to corporate credit ratings.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种基于图的最大成对差异（MPD）检验，用于比较K个样本的分布。该检验可用于识别对多个多元分布异质性贡献最大的信息变量。为构建此检验，我们首先将多个样本的观测值合并，基于任意两个观测值之间的距离构建相似图。随后，对每个观测值，评估其与各样本的连接概率。接着，通过样本内与样本间的双重最大化，对这些连接概率的平方差进行最大化处理。因此，MPD检验是一种平方最大值检验，能有效检测稀疏备择假设。此外，我们展示了检验统计量的渐近零分布，并确立了其在备择假设下的一致性。为说明所提检验的有限样本性能，我们进行了广泛的模拟研究。结果表明，MPD检验优于一些常用的多样本检验。最后，我们将其应用于与企业信用评级相关的特征选择。
title: Graph-based multisample comparison with application to feature selection for multi-category responses
title_zh: 基于图的多样本比较及其在多类别响应特征选择中的应用

abstract: Governments increasingly use protection and targeted subsidies to promote domestic firms. These policies are usually evaluated in the market they target. This column uses India's 4G rollout to show why that can be misleading when products and infrastructure are complements. Restricting low-priced Chinese phones slowed 4G network expansion and did not raise Indian phone firms' profits, while a subsidy open to all 4G phones accelerated coverage more than a domestic-only subsidy.
abstract_zh: 各国政府日益采用保护措施和定向补贴来扶持本土企业。这些政策通常在所针对的市场中进行评估。本文利用印度4G网络的推广案例，说明当产品与基础设施为互补品时，此类评估可能产生误导。限制低价中国手机减缓了4G网络的扩展，且并未提升印度手机企业的利润，而面向所有4G手机的补贴在加速网络覆盖方面，效果优于仅限本土企业的补贴。
authors: Chirantan Chatterjee, Ying Fan, Debi Prasad Mohapatra
china_relevance_reason: 研究以印度4G推广为案例，但核心分析对象是中国低价手机及其政策影响，涉及中国产品和企业，因此与中国研究直接相关。
title: Industrial policy in complementary markets: Lessons from India's 4G rollout
title_zh: 互补市场中的产业政策：来自印度4G推广的经验教训

abstract: Housing shortages and rising rents have become a source of political pressure in many countries, prompting calls for stronger intervention in rental markets. This column shows that the effects of such intervention can outlast the policy itself: in Berlin, the 2020 rent cap was followed by continued debate over expropriation and further regulation, and the city’s price-rent ratio remained 10%–15% below trend even three years after repeal. The findings suggest that credible threats of future intervention can depress housing valuations, alter market structure, and weaken construction activity even when no regulation is currently in force.
abstract_zh: 住房短缺与租金上涨已成为多国政治压力的来源，促使人们呼吁对租赁市场进行更强有力的干预。本专栏指出，此类干预的影响可能比政策本身更为持久：在柏林，2020年的租金上限政策之后，关于征用和进一步监管的讨论持续不断，即便在政策废除三年后，该市的房价租金比仍低于趋势水平10%至15%。研究结果表明，即使当前没有实施任何监管，未来干预的可信威胁也能压低住房估值、改变市场结构，并削弱建设活动。
authors: Clemens Fuest, David Gstrein, Carla Krolage, Florian Neumeier
title: How regulatory risk and expropriation threats are affecting Berlin’s housing market
title_zh: 监管风险与征收威胁如何影响柏林住房市场
